name: High Cable Bicep Curl (Single Arm)
description: A single-arm high cable curl. Set a high pulley — either a cable column with a single D-handle, or a pulley/weight-stack station, whichever is free. Stand to the side of the cable with the upper arm raised out to shoulder level and parallel to the floor, fixed throughout the rep. Curl the handle toward the head/ear, squeezing the bicep at peak contraction, then control back without bouncing at the start. The high, fixed arm position keeps constant tension and emphasizes the bicep peak. The stack scales differ between the cable column and the pulley station, so record which one was used.
